bagPolicy.summary: Small bags may be brought into the theater; large bags and backpacks must be checked for $5 per item. Bag check is mandatory for larger bags.
prohibited: Large bags on the concert floor
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Paid street meters, lots and ramps surround the Palace Theatre in St. Paul. The nearby Victory and Lawson Commons ramps typically cost $8–$15 depending on parking time.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue FAQ does not designate a Palace Theatre rideshare pickup point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Palace Pub next door sells food and drinks and opens at 3 p.m. Tuesday–Saturday, plus event days on Sunday and Monday.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Buy ADA tickets on the accessible-seating tile; one guest requiring accessible seating can purchase up to three companion tickets. The Palace floor is generally standing room only, and the first balcony level has elevator access.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The Palace Theatre section of the operator FAQ does not state a general re-entry rule.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Bring valid photo ID to claim will-call tickets. The adjacent Palace Pub also sells event tickets at its front desk.

gates.summary: A valid photo ID is required for entry; door time is specific to the concert. Large bags and backpacks must be checked for $5 per item.
